items.prompt: For input [5,-10], why must best remain separate from the final ending state?

options.text: The final ending is 5 and best is -5.
options.why: Those states are reversed: the best final suffix sums to -5.

options.text: The final ending is -10 and best is 0.
options.why: Extending[5] gives suffix -5, and a nonempty best need not be 0.

options.text: The final ending is -5, but the global best is 5.
options.why: The optimal interval can end before the final index.

options.text: Both states must equal the whole-array sum -5.
options.why: Only ending is constrained to the current endpoint.

items.explanation: The optimal interval can end before the final index.
